artifact_review:

The Topology Auditor's mask shows a disconnected component in that region (see mask image: isolated white shape on bottom left). This confirms a topological fragmentation error. Severity 3 is justified as it represents a physical impossibility (floating/detached material) or severe anatomical distortion.

While this is partly due to domain shift (AI image vs real training data), the complete failure to detect valid foot anatomy supports the visual observation that the foot structure is poorly defined or distorted, reinforcing the 'pink blob' anomaly.
